reviews.title: Awesome App
reviews.text: I love this app. It’s easy to use, works very well, exactly what I wanted, best option for me. I gave it one star because every single time I open it and start to record. I get a pop-up asking me to review the app. You would’ve gotten five stars if you would just let me record instead of interrupting me every time.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Don’t waste your time. This doesn’t work. There is no way to create a document or add your script into the app. I wasn’t missing something. I spent a long time troubleshooting this. It literally does not work.

reviews.title: Underwhelmed
reviews.text: I am supposed to be able to upload a script. So far all I have are glitches.

reviews.title: Glitches
reviews.text: Literally I’ll try to record and it doesn’t record anything and then it’s a blank screen

reviews.title: No access to pro after paying
reviews.text: I followed the upgrade to pro and the purchase completed. I got nothing. I’m going to demand a refund!

reviews.title: No paste feature anymore?
reviews.text: So you update it and I can’t do with this version what I could do in the ancient version on my old iPad mini 2: PASTE FROM NOTES! 1 star until fixed. Also, where’s the ability to have several scripts? Gone? Hidden? Thumbs down.
